content_html:
watched #Khaidi150…..assalu tamil ollaki adhi oka goppa story anni ella anipinchindho?? Telugu lo same story line based 150 cinemalu chupinchachu 🙂 but wait a minute…..did I watch the movie for a different story or execution?? NO its BOSS comeback movie!!! and yes The Boss who had kick ass comedy timing is back….The Boss who is pitch perfect as drunkurd is back…..The Boss who is at best in emotional scenes is back……The Boss who sets Silver screen on Fire with his graceful steps is back….and YES the BOXOFFICE amma mogudu is BACK with Bang!!!! My 4 year old daughter danced in the theater for the songs and Yes the biggest entertainer of Telugu Film Industry is back

Boss gurunchi thappa cinema lo chepukodaniki emmi ledhu…..but Boss okkadu challu 😛
